name: todo-webapp
description: A single-page todo list app. A visitor adds, completes, and deletes short text todos in one flat list. There is no sign-in and no backend: all data is read from and written to the browser's own local storage, so the app has no server-side API and no database. Does not support editing a todo's text, filtering by status, bulk-clearing completed items, or any multi-user or cross-device sync.
